terra.problem: The line is too absolute: “the River” does not always mean the Euphrates. Easton’s source notes a reference to the Jordan in Psalm 66:6. Also, Abraham’s family lived beyond the Euphrates, not in the river itself.
“Choose whom you will serve” takes place at Shechem, not at the Euphrates or beyond it. Joshua mentions the region beyond the river, but the speech itself does not happen there.
“Perennial” is above the requested reading level. Consider “a river that flows all year.”
